pause.title: Pause this loop?
pause.effect: It stops running until you resume it.
pause.note: If nobody has its chat open, the agent may close it, ending the loop.
delete.title: Delete this loop?
delete.effect: It stops and is removed. Its chat stays.
extend.title: Change when this loop ends
extend.label: Ends
extend.expired: Expired: a new end time restarts it.
restart.title: Start this loop again?
restart.effect: Its spending and running time count from zero; its run count stays. The next run is one interval from now.
restart.noLimits: It has no spending or running-time limit.
restart.again: Its stop condition is checked again after each run.
replace.title: Change timing or prompt
replace.body: This stops the loop, then starts a new one in the same chat.
new.title: New loop
new.subtitle: It repeats a prompt in one chat on {{computer}}.
new.chatsFailed: Your chats could not be read. Try again.
new.noChats: No open chat to add a loop to. Start a chat first.
f.promptHelp: Sent into the chat on every run.
f.fireNow: Run once now, then on the timer
f.maxWallHelp: All runs together. Empty: no limit.
f.memory: It ends with its chat or an agent restart. At most 8 run on {{computer}}.
p.maxRuns: Enter a whole number of runs, 1 or more.
p.endsShort: It would end before its first run.
p.maxCost: Enter an amount above 0, in dollars and cents, or leave it empty.
p.maxWall: Enter a whole number above 0, or leave it empty.
p.tooBig: This limit is too large to set here. Lower it, or leave it empty for no limit.
o.done.runNow: It runs on the next tick
o.seen.delete: The loop is no longer listed.
o.refused: The agent refused this. Nothing was changed.
o.refused.changed: The loop changed before this reached it, so nothing was changed. Review it again.
o.refused.notFound: The agent could not find this loop for you. Nothing was changed.
o.refused.chatNotFound: The agent could not find this chat on {{computer}} for you. Nothing started.
o.refused.create: The agent refused the new loop. Nothing started.
o.refused.replaceCreate: The old loop is gone; the new one was refused.
o.unsure.detail: Check again only reads; it sends nothing.
o.unsure.noProof: The loop as it is now cannot show which request changed it.
o.unsure.replaceDelete: The old loop may still be running. Nothing new was started.
o.unsure.create: A loop may have started. Check again never starts another.
o.same: The chat's loops do not show it yet.
o.readFailed: The chat’s loops could not be read. Try again later.
o.awaiting: The old loop is gone; the new one is not started.
cand.title: These loops in the chat match. One may be yours:
cand.none: No matching loop started since you sent it.
confirm.unreadable: The loop could not be read, or this is no longer offered.
o.notSent.changed: This changed, so nothing was sent.
o.notSent.read: The chat's loops could not be read, so nothing was sent.
a.label: Actions for this loop
a.busy: Wait for the change on its way.
f.memoryQ: How long does a loop last?
new.needChat: Pick the chat the loop runs in.
